title: OAuth app registration rejects http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 redirect URIs as "non-loopback", with HTTP 500
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-22** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, OAuth Applications → Register, type Web.
- **Expected:** the field's help, "Must use https:// in production" (loopback http allowed).
- **Actual:** `POST /api/v1/auth/sys-oauth-application/register` → **500**, toast "web clients require https redirect URIs on non-loopback hosts: http://localhost:4001/callback" (same for `127.0.0.1`). `https://qa.example.com/callback` registers.
- **Evidence:** [`40-F-oauth-localhost-rejected-500.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/40-F-oauth-localhost-rejected-500.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** anyone registering a local or dev OAuth client.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `plugin-auth` OAuth provider (loopback detection, and a validation error raised as 500).
- **Dedupe words:** oauth redirect loopback localhost rejected, non-loopback hosts, register 500.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `plugin-auth`, the OAuth application registration validation.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 hits in objectstack, 0 in objectui. **New.**
